name: Windliner
description: The Windliner was a Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport used by a Sullustan engineer to transport cargo during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, the Windliner carried stock for the merchant Jonkah Rremset to the moon Toshara, though the cargo was confiscated by a Galactic Empire customs officer on Renpalli Station as a result of Rremset's failure to meet payments.
